ios.desc:
ActionMate is a practical tool designed to enhance the usage of Action Button in conjunction with the Shortcut app.

The action button is a new physical button added to the iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max models, replacing the silent mode switch. It is recommended to use ActionMate on iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max models for the best experience.

Although the iOS system provides several default action button functions, ActionMate can help you greatly expand the function usage of the action button. Pressing the function button in different states can trigger various features, such as:

- Pressing the action button in portrait mode to turn silent mode on/off; pressing it in landscape mode will open the camera.
- Pressing the action button when the device screen is facing up will display a payment QR code; pressing it when the screen is facing down will start a one-touch recording.
- Shaking the device after pressing the action button will change the wallpaper; not shaking the device after pressing will take a screenshot and share it directly.
...

These are just a few basic examples of ActionMate's capabilities. With the high degree of freedom provided by the iOS Shortcut app, you can use ActionMate to stack a wide variety of complex functions.

Even if you're not familiar with the iOS Shortcut app, ActionMate includes and will continue to update a number of sample shortcuts for one-click access. It also provides a number of shortcut usage tutorials to help you solve any problems.

ActionMate will continue to improve in the long term. If you have any feature suggestions, please contact us through the App's built-in feedback mechanism.

quotes.text:
I've been working on an app to extend the new Action Button on iPhone 15 Pro (Max) these days and now it's ready to use. Have a try and feedback is welcomed!

ActionMate is now on App Store. ActionMate is a practical tool designed to enhance the usage of Action Button in conjunction with the Shortcut app.

Two notable features that I added to Shortcuts include:

- Volume Button Change Detection: This action recognizes when the volume button is adjusted, offering different functionality based on the action taken.

- Shake Gesture Detection: Identify when the device is shaken, allowing for unique actions to be triggered by the motion.

These advanced actions enable users to create shortcuts like a combination of long-pressing the action button and shaking the device to launch Shazam for music recognition or long-pressing the action button and tapping a volume button to initiate various other actions. Please note that these two requires a pro in-app purchase to unlock.
